Settings

← Back

Changes apply immediately. The ; leader opens the which-key overlay — Tab / Shift+Tab flips pages, arrows select, or press a binding's key.

General

Leader key, link hints, and core key behaviour.

Quick-launch

Web apps shown as tiles on the command-center home grid. Toggle each on or off; edit the name / URL or add your own. The favicon is pulled live from each site.

Sessions

;p save & switch named sets, ;' + 1-9 jump to a marker, ;| split, ;{/;} swap panes, ;\ close the split view.

Dark mode

Applies to web pages. ;Y d toggles the site you are on, ;Y g cycles the default, ;Y e switches the engine for one site, ;Y x clears that site's rules. The engine measures each page before painting it: a page that is already dark is left alone, and a page whose colours it cannot read is inverted rather than half-mapped. Details in docs/DARK-MODE.md.
One rule per site. A pattern is a host (example.com, which also covers its subdomains), a wildcard (*.example.com, example.*), or a host with a path (example.com/docs). "Inherit" leaves that part to the default above. The more specific rule wins, whichever order they are in.
Plain text, one block per site, blocks separated by a line of ====. Directives: INVERT, NO INVERT, REMOVE BG, CSS, IGNORE INLINE STYLE, IGNORE IMAGE ANALYSIS, IGNORE CSS URL. A list written for Dark Reader can be pasted in as it is; in this theme ${white} means the text colour and ${black} the canvas, exactly as there.
Export copies this card and the reader card into the box as JSON; paste JSON into it and press apply to load it back into the form (nothing is saved until you press Save).

Reader mode

;R extracts the article on the page you are on and shows it in place of everything else. Links, find, the yank modes and the scroll keys all keep working inside it, and Esc leaves.

Firefox chrome

Handled by chrome/userChrome.uc.js (installed by the Lazyfox installer). These hotkeys open Firefox's built-in pages and work even on about: / error pages where the extension can't run.

Components

Each Lazyfox piece versions independently: the extension, the Go wasm core, the native messaging host, and the chrome helper installed by the installer.
